verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh is a KYC/AML compliance platform, so document-plus-selfie identity verification is a fair question for this kind of product and the axis applies. The evidence only covers sanctions/PEP/adverse-media screening, risk scoring, onboarding screening workflows, and webhooks. Nothing documents document capture, selfie or liveness checks, or a hosted or drop-in verification flow, and the onboarding and webhook features are adjacent screening capabilities that earn no credit here.
